Reviewer view: the judge's full reasoning

To the rider: your dispute is not upheld, and the SGD 4.50 no-show fee stands as charged (EV-FARE-02718: cancellation_fee 4.50, payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00). Your driver accepted at 20:32:01, reached the pickup point at 20:36:57, and cancelled at 20:39:58 under RIDER_NO_SHOW. POL-NS-01 requires all four conditions and each holds: (a) EV-TRIP-02718 carries the driver's 'arrived' event at 20:36:57; (b) EV-GPS-02718 places him inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius from that same moment, with 19 consecutive qualifying in-radius fixes where the clause needs 3; (c) he held position in the geofence for a continuous 181 seconds (EV-GPS-02718, longest_qualifying_run.duration_sec = 181.0) against the 180-second free waiting period in force (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180); and (d) no boarding was recorded, and the trip was terminated by the driver under RIDER_NO_SHOW at 20:39:58, after the dwell elapsed. Your submission that the driver 'cancelled almost immediately' is not supported by that sequence. Your argument that the platform's own wait timer shows 179 seconds (started 20:36:59, cancelled 20:39:58) is rejected: POL-NS-01(c) expressly measures the dwell from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix and not from the 'arrived' event or the platform timer, and that is the 181-second run. The 2-second gap between the first in-geofence fix (20:36:57) and the timer start (20:36:59) is timer lag, not a shortfall. POL-NS-12 (which would treat the platform's own arrival and wait-timer events as an independent carrier) applies only to a GPS_AUTO marker; here platform_policy.arrival_marker is BUTTON, so the qualifying-fix test governs. Your POL-NS-06 shortfall claim therefore fails: derived shortfall_sec is -1.0, a surplus, so nothing is refunded. Your further submission that the wait clock is unmeasurable and the case should go to human review is rejected for the same reason: the clause fixes the measurement, 181.0 seconds against 180, so there is no unresolved conflict between admissible artifacts. POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate you either: limb (a) requires a rider locating message, and EV-CHAT-02718 holds one message, the driver's own at 20:37:17 ('im at the pickup point', read 20:37:47), with no rider reply; separately, your device's 41 fixes lie 874.8-880.9 m from the pin (rider_qualifying_fix_count 0 against a 100 m radius). POL-NS-03 does not reach this trip - the driver's stationary fixes are inside the arrival radius - and POL-NS-05 records no false marker, since the marker coincides with the first qualifying in-geofence fix (dwell_start_offset_sec 0.0), so no false-arrival referral is entered. To the driver: your compensation is paid. POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it, so under POL-NS-07 you receive 80 percent of the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee, SGD 3.60, the residual 20 percent being retained as the platform service fee. The anti-farming check does not trip: EV-DPROF-02718 records 0 no-show terminations in the trailing 30 days against 62 completed trips, so neither limb is met, nothing is withheld and no escalation follows. The fee itself is unchanged - the rider's charge stands - and under POL-GEN-03 amount_sgd carries the same SGD 3.60 as driver_compensation_sgd, being the amount this ruling moves. Confidence: every artifact this ruling rests on (EV-GPS-02718, EV-TRIP-02718, EV-FARE-02718, EV-DPROF-02718) carries weight_multiplier 1.0 and status COMPLETE, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0 and my confidence is 0.90, above the 0.70 floor fixed by POL-NS-09. No POL-NS-09 trigger applies: no counter-party dispute history (both disputes_with_counterparty_90d are 0), no abuse counter (rider no_show_disputes_30d is 1), no direct contradiction between admissible artifacts that a clause leaves unresolved, and no deciding fact resting on impaired evidence. The monetary effect, SGD 3.60, is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold. One rider claim concerning the missing traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02718-01 was discarded at the mechanical citation check for not naming its issue code; it bears on no shortfall, because no shortfall arises.

How to appeal: You may appeal once within 30 days (POL-GEN-04). A different human reviewer hears it, and only record evidence may be added.

POL-GEN-05: the monetary effect is SGD 3.60 against an execution threshold of SGD 8.00. It does not exceed the threshold, so the amount is executed automatically on issue, subject to POL-GEN-04.

Read POL-GEN-04 in full
Every ruling issued without human review is a provisional ruling. Either party may appeal it once, within 30 days of the trip or of the ruling's issue, whichever is later, by lodging the appeal with the platform's help channel. An appeal (a) is heard by a human reviewer who did not take part in any earlier review of the same trip; (b) may add only record-type evidence - a GPS export, a fare or payment statement, an ERP gantry record with gantry name, entry time and cashcard statement, a call log, a photograph with its capture time - and may not add or amend a party statement; (c) suspends execution of any amount not yet executed and freezes it until decided, and where the amount was executed under POL-GEN-05 before the appeal, a successful appeal reverses it; (d) may not be withdrawn and re-lodged. A second appeal on the same trip, an appeal lodged after 30 days, or an appeal that adds only statements is refused. The appeal decision is recorded as a human closure under POL-GEN-06, enters the precedent store, and is final on the platform. This clause licenses no ruling value: an appeal is a route to human review, not a ruling, and it is lodged after a ruling has issued.

To the rider: your dispute is not upheld, and the SGD 4.50 no-show fee stands as charged (EV-FARE-02718: cancellation_fee 4.50, payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00). Your driver accepted at 20:32:01, reached the pickup point at 20:36:57, and cancelled at 20:39:58 under RIDER_NO_SHOW. POL-NS-01 requires all four conditions and each holds: (a) EV-TRIP-02718 carries the driver's 'arrived' event at 20:36:57; (b) EV-GPS-02718 places him inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius from that same moment, with 19 consecutive qualifying in-radius fixes where the clause needs 3; (c) he held position in the geofence for a continuous 181 seconds (EV-GPS-02718, longest_qualifying_run.duration_sec = 181.0) against the 180-second free waiting period in force (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180); and (d) no boarding was recorded, and the trip was terminated by the driver under RIDER_NO_SHOW at 20:39:58, after the dwell elapsed. Your submission that the driver 'cancelled almost immediately' is not supported by that sequence. Your argument that the platform's own wait timer shows 179 seconds (started 20:36:59, cancelled 20:39:58) is rejected: POL-NS-01(c) expressly measures the dwell from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix and not from the 'arrived' event or the platform timer, and that is the 181-second run. The 2-second gap between the first in-geofence fix (20:36:57) and the timer start (20:36:59) is timer lag, not a shortfall. POL-NS-12 (which would treat the platform's own arrival and wait-timer events as an independent carrier) applies only to a GPS_AUTO marker; here platform_policy.arrival_marker is BUTTON, so the qualifying-fix test governs. Your POL-NS-06 shortfall claim therefore fails: derived shortfall_sec is -1.0, a surplus, so nothing is refunded. Your further submission that the wait clock is unmeasurable and the case should go to human review is rejected for the same reason: the clause fixes the measurement, 181.0 seconds against 180, so there is no unresolved conflict between admissible artifacts. POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate you either: limb (a) requires a rider locating message, and EV-CHAT-02718 holds one message, the driver's own at 20:37:17 ('im at the pickup point', read 20:37:47), with no rider reply; separately, your device's 41 fixes lie 874.8-880.9 m from the pin (rider_qualifying_fix_count 0 against a 100 m radius). To the driver: your compensation is paid. POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it, so under POL-NS-07 you receive 80 percent of the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee, SGD 3.60, the residual 20 percent being retained as the platform service fee. The anti-farming check does not trip: EV-DPROF-02718 records 0 no-show terminations in the trailing 30 days against 62 completed trips, so neither limb is met, nothing is withheld and no escalation follows. The fee itself is unchanged - the rider's charge stands - and under POL-GEN-03 amount_sgd carries the same SGD 3.60 as driver_compensation_sgd, being the amount this ruling moves. Confidence: every artifact this ruling rests on (EV-GPS-02718, EV-TRIP-02718, EV-FARE-02718, EV-DPROF-02718) carries weight_multiplier 1.0 and status COMPLETE, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0 and my confidence is 0.90, above the 0.70 floor fixed by POL-NS-09. The monetary effect, SGD 3.60, is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold.
